test_suite_name: V3 Orion Arrival and Targeting Acceptance
description: After a serving-server restart, ordinary-player warp and transwarp arrivals in the Orion center sector are tested against the real Orion blockader scheduler with authoritative combat and SQL state assertions.

tests.name: Bootstrap disposable SysOp session
Reconnect hostile ordinary player after restart
Reconnect allied ordinary player after restart
Read Orion controlled-sector center after restart

data.sql: SELECT center_sector FROM clusters WHERE role='ORION' LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Read non-FedSpace route origin after restart

data.sql: SELECT MIN(sector_id) FROM sectors WHERE sector_id>10 AND sector_id<>@{orion_arrival_home};

tests.name: Disable NPC task while preparing player arrivals

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET enabled=FALSE WHERE name='npc_step';

tests.name: Defer unrelated cron jobs for the focused real scheduler tick

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET next_due_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+INTERVAL '1 day' WHERE name<>'npc_step' AND enabled=TRUE;

tests.name: Put both ordinary players at the common route origin

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=@{orion_arrival_origin} WHERE name IN ('orion_arrival_hostile','orion_arrival_allied');

tests.name: Prepare ships for normal warp and one-hop transwarp

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=@{orion_arrival_origin},has_transwarp=TRUE,shields=0,hull=100,fighters=100,ore=3,onplanet=FALSE,destroyed=FALSE WHERE ship_id IN (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name IN ('orion_arrival_hostile','orion_arrival_allied'));

tests.name: Synchronize Fuel Ore for transwarp

data.sql: INSERT INTO ship_cargo(ship_id,commodity_code,quantity) SELECT ship_id,'ORE',3 FROM players WHERE name IN ('orion_arrival_hostile','orion_arrival_allied') ON CONFLICT(ship_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity=3;

tests.name: Position the NPC Orion blockader and keep four NPC patrols

data.sql: WITH faction AS (SELECT s.ship_id,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY s.ship_id) AS n FROM ships s JOIN ship_ownership so ON so.ship_id=s.ship_id JOIN players p ON p.player_id=so.player_id AND p.is_npc=TRUE JOIN corp_members cm ON cm.player_id=so.player_id JOIN corporations c ON c.corporation_id=cm.corporation_id WHERE c.tag='ORION' AND COALESCE(s.destroyed,FALSE)=FALSE), changed AS (UPDATE ships s SET sector_id=@{orion_arrival_home},personality=CASE WHEN f.n=1 THEN 'blockader' ELSE 'defensive' END,shields=0,hull=100,destroyed=FALSE FROM faction f WHERE s.ship_id=f.ship_id RETURNING s.ship_id) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM changed;

tests.name: Refresh authoritative contexts after restart
Refresh allied player's authoritative context
Orion member enters through normal warp and is protected from its blockader
Non-allied player enters through transwarp
Both travel mechanisms reach Orion-controlled sector

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players WHERE name IN ('orion_arrival_hostile','orion_arrival_allied') AND sector_id=@{orion_arrival_home})=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

tests.name: Record hostile hull before NPC combat

data.sql: SELECT hull FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='orion_arrival_hostile');

tests.name: Schedule immediate serving-engine NPC step
Verify npc_step is present and due

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND BOOL_AND(enabled AND next_due_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM cron_tasks WHERE name='npc_step';

tests.name: Allow serving engine to run the isolated Orion scheduler
Verify cron rescheduled npc_step after execution

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN next_due_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM cron_tasks WHERE name='npc_step';

tests.name: Hostile arrival takes one NPC combat hit while Orion ally is untouched

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT hull FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='orion_arrival_hostile'))<@{orion_hull_before} AND (SELECT hull FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='orion_arrival_allied'))=100 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM npc_action_log WHERE faction='ORION' AND action_type='blockade_attack' AND target_player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='orion_arrival_hostile') AND sector_id=@{orion_arrival_home} AND status='completed')=1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM npc_action_log WHERE faction='ORION' AND action_type='blockade_attack' AND target_player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='orion_arrival_allied')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

tests.name: Orion scheduler does not claim or move a human corporation member ship as an NPC

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM npc_action_log l JOIN ship_ownership so ON so.ship_id=l.npc_ship_id JOIN players p ON p.player_id=so.player_id JOIN corp_members cm ON cm.player_id=p.player_id JOIN corporations c ON c.corporation_id=cm.corporation_id WHERE c.tag='ORION' AND p.is_npc=FALSE;

tests.name: Capture hull after first NPC action

data.sql: SELECT hull FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='orion_arrival_hostile');

tests.name: Force idempotent scheduler retry

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET next_due_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE name='npc_step';

tests.name: Allow retry tick
Same-window scheduler retry does not repeat combat damage

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT hull FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='orion_arrival_hostile'))=@{orion_hull_after} AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM npc_action_log WHERE faction='ORION' AND action_type='blockade_attack' AND target_player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='orion_arrival_hostile') AND sector_id=@{orion_arrival_home} AND status='completed')=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

tests.name: Logout hostile player
Logout Orion-allied player
